niche.title: The Weird Original Purpose of Bubble Wrap 😲#Shorts #BubbleWrap #Inventions
niche.description:
Bubble wrap wasn't originally invented to protect packages! 😱 In 1957, Alfred Fielding and Marc Chavannes developed it as a textured plastic wallpaper. When that idea failed to catch on, they eventually found a practical use for protecting fragile items during shipping.

Discover the surprising history behind one of the world's most satisfying inventions!
